newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Martin says long GM strike to hurt.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Martin says long GM strike to hurt.

text.p: Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin said on Wednesday a protacted strike at General Motors Corp's Canadian unit would hurt the economy just at the point when the economy was about to take off.
Asked if a protacted strike would hurt the economic assumptions underlying his budgets, he said:

"There's no doubt that a protracted General Motors strike will have an effect on the economy that would be marked, which is why I very, very much hope that both management and labor can get back to the table and find a solution, because we really are now just at the point of economic takeoff and this obviously will have an effect."
He said the qualifier would have to be whether the strike would be lengthy.
More than 21,000 Canadian Auto Workers members are on strike over GM demands to be able to send more parts work to outside suppliers.
